column1: # pstack worker roster for claude-worker and ~/.claude/rules/pstack-workers.md.
# A pstack role names a worker as worker/<alias>. claude-worker resolves the alias
# to the provider model id in provider.env. `claude-worker doctor` checks every id
# against the provider model list. Current provider: OpenCode Go. Model ids and
# allowances are the Go plan values documented on 2026-11-02
